Headline: GE 2004 results: NDA loses
Context: 'India Shining' NDA lost unexpectedly; Left-backed UPA formed government. Fear of Left influence on reforms led to the 17-May 'Black Monday' crash with trading halted twice.

Headline: GE 2009 results: UPA wins without Left
Context: UPA won a stronger-than-expected mandate without needing Left support. On Monday 18-May the market hit the upper circuit twice and trading closed for the day.

Headline: GE 2014 results: BJP majority
Context: First single-party majority in 30 years. Exit polls had predicted an NDA win, so much of the rally happened before results; the size of the majority was a positive surprise.

Headline: GE 2019 results: NDA re-elected bigger
Context: NDA re-elected with a larger majority; largely priced in after the exit-poll rally of 20-May.

Headline: GE 2024 results: BJP short of majority
Context: Exit polls predicted a landslide; BJP won 240 seats and needed allies. Nifty fell sharply on results day and recovered within days once the NDA government was confirmed.

Headline: GE 2019 exit polls predict NDA win
Context: Exit polls released on Sunday 19-May predicted an NDA majority; big relief rally on Monday.

Headline: GE 2024 exit polls predict landslide
Context: Exit polls on 1-June predicted 350+ seats for NDA; record-high rally on Monday 3-June, reversed next day on actual results.

Headline: Gujarat 2007: BJP retains
Context: BJP retained Gujarat. Result declared on a Sunday; reaction on next trading day.

Headline: UP 2012: SP wins; Congress weak
Context: Samajwadi Party won UP; poor show by the ruling Congress raised concerns about reform momentum at the Centre.

Headline: Delhi/Raj/MP/Chh 2013: BJP wins 3 of 4
Context: Seen as a semi-final before GE 2014; BJP wins boosted 'Modi rally' expectations. Results on a Sunday.

Headline: Delhi 2015: AAP sweep
Context: AAP won 67 of 70 seats; BJP defeat seen as a dent to the central government's momentum.

Headline: Bihar 2015: BJP alliance loses
Context: Mahagathbandhan defeated the BJP-led alliance; concern about reform bills in Rajya Sabha. Results on a Sunday.

Headline: UP 2017: BJP landslide
Context: BJP won over 300 seats in UP; strengthened reform expectations. Results on Saturday; Monday was a Holi holiday.

Headline: Gujarat/HP 2017: BJP retains
Context: Early counting showed a close fight and the market fell sharply in the morning, then recovered as BJP pulled ahead.

Headline: Karnataka 2018: hung assembly
Context: BJP single largest but short of majority; Congress-JD(S) later formed the government.

Headline: MP/Raj/Chh 2018: BJP loses three states
Context: Congress won three Hindi-belt states; same week as RBI Governor Urjit Patel's resignation.

Headline: West Bengal 2021: TMC wins
Context: TMC retained Bengal against a strong BJP push; results on a Sunday during the COVID second wave.

Headline: UP 2022: BJP retains
Context: BJP retained UP, AAP won Punjab; policy continuity seen ahead of GE 2024.

Headline: Gujarat/HP 2022
Context: BJP won a record majority in Gujarat; Congress won Himachal Pradesh.

Headline: Karnataka 2023: Congress wins
Context: Congress won Karnataka with a clear majority. Results on a Saturday.

Headline: MP/Raj/Chh 2023: BJP sweep
Context: BJP won all three Hindi-belt states, more than expected; strong rally on Monday 4-Dec. Results on a Sunday.

Headline: Haryana 2024: BJP surprise win
Context: Exit polls predicted a Congress win; BJP won a third term.

Headline: Maharashtra 2024: Mahayuti landslide
Context: Ruling alliance won a large majority; strong rally on Monday 25-Nov. Results on a Saturday.

Headline: Delhi 2025: BJP wins
Context: BJP won Delhi after 27 years. Results on a Saturday.

Headline: Bihar 2025: NDA landslide
Context: NDA won a large majority in Bihar.
